package com.acme.loyalty.model;

/**
 * Membership tiers, lowest first. Codes are the single-letter values stored in LOYALTY_MEMBER.TIER_CD.
 */
public enum Tier {
    BRONZE("B", 1.0),
    SILVER("S", 1.25),
    GOLD("G", 1.5),
    PLATINUM("P", 2.0);

    private final String code;
    private final double multiplier;

    Tier(final String code, final double multiplier) {
        this.code = code;
        this.multiplier = multiplier;
    }

    public String code() {
        return code;
    }

    public double multiplier() {
        return multiplier;
    }

    /** Points earned for a spend amount in cents, rounded down. */
    public int pointsFor(final long spendCents) {
        return (int) Math.floor(spendCents / 100.0 * multiplier);
    }

    public Tier next() {
        switch (this) {
            case BRONZE:
                return SILVER;
            case SILVER:
                return GOLD;
            case GOLD:
                return PLATINUM;
            default:
                return this;
        }
    }

    public static Tier fromCode(final String code) {
        for (Tier tier : values()) {
            if (tier.code.equalsIgnoreCase(code)) {
                return tier;
            }
        }
        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown tier code: " + code);
    }
}
